title: 享受约会是主要的，收尾结果只是顺便的事情

timeline.summary: A viewer asks whether to keep a date when the woman has a firm early departure time; Mikey says the date can still happen.
He criticizes treating first-date sex as mandatory and recommends enjoying ordinary conversation rather than making the encounter entirely outcome-driven.
He calls his own one-date sexual outcome content a display of skill and recounts increasingly compressed targets, ending with inviting women home without a date.
Repeated outro within the media boundary; no additional claim. Later ASR repetition is excluded.

claims.conditions: Both people retain their time limits, consent and right to leave; a later date is not guaranteed.
